title: Activate the new persona and recent multi-turn chat locally
objective: Make the daily local Closure use the reviewed role card and application-owned recent conversation, preserve current model/voice compatibility, and deliver a locally runnable version for user validation without pushing, PR publication, CI or merging.
architecture: User explicitly requested local replacement first and no push. Codex implements directly under the existing override; the current isolated checkout is reused on codex/character-dialogue-local, based on the committed design 9c13606. Do not invoke Claude, publish, finalize, push, create a PR, run remote CI or merge.

Adopt and hash the exact seven public live-only AI sources/tests before implementation. Preserve configured model and existing reasoning-effort selection, sampling compatibility and SSE error handling. No private configuration, credentials, user schedules, weights or audio are opened or copied into this checkout.

Load the exact reviewed compact role card from a dedicated bundled resource and keep the reply JSON contract in a separate resource. Remove the old example-anchored prompt and unsupported health assumptions from the chat opener. Current environment facts and explicit lack of persistent memory remain separate runtime context.

ChatService owns a serialized request queue and an in-memory conversation independent of ChatWindow. The pet application owns the service and passes it to chat windows. Hiding or recreating a window retains completed turns; application restart clears them. New conversation explicitly cancels unfinished requests and clears history.

Send at most the latest 12 complete pairs under a 24000 Unicode-code-point history budget; never truncate a turn or replay speechText as a second message. Keep a bounded display transcript separately. The current user input is included once. No summaries, SQLite, long-term facts, retrieval or provider switch are implemented in this stage.

Commit a pair only after a successful terminal model event and a complete validated reply object. Errors, cancellation, stale callbacks and partial/invalid JSON do not commit assistant history or emit speech. Queued requests are built after the preceding commit. Per-request cancellation reaches the transport when supported.

Preserve declared dominant intent rather than overriding it from a mix of lexical cues. Keep existing readable speech sanitization and genuine-question repair. Expose stop and new-conversation controls with no extra model calls.

Validate locally using deterministic fake clients and loopback SSE, the full offline unit suite, package and real native startup. Produce head-bound local report, packet and review. These are local engineering checks, not model-quality scores, remote CI, merge evidence or user acceptance.

After local review, install only explicitly reviewed source/resource/test files into the actual daily runtime using exact baseline checks and recoverable backups. Preserve all other customized sources and private settings. Build and smoke-check the actual runtime, then gracefully restart only the identified pet app. No real chat/TTS inference or training is performed by the agent.
non_goals: No push, PR, remote CI, merge, cloud deployment, purchases or paid inference.
No model replacement, provider benchmark, prompt-example training, TTS adapter replacement, animation change or Spine licence assertion.
No persistent chat store, summary generation, SQLite long-term memory or claim that memory survives process restart.
No real user transcript/configuration export, secrets/audio/weights reads, blanket copy or cleanup of the dirty original workspace.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Actual chat requests use the exact reviewed role card plus a separate output contract and current runtime context, retaining the existing model/reasoning compatibility.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Resource equality/hash checks, captured real ChatService requests and preserved-adapter tests.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Requests include recent complete turns in order, bounded by pair/character budget; the second queued request is built after the first successful commit and assistant JSON appears once.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Deterministic fake-client tests for references, queue order, history serialization and budget eviction.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Failure, incomplete/malformed responses, cancellation and late callbacks never commit successful history or emit stale UI/voice; stop and explicit new conversation work.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Fault/cancel/retry/reset race tests and loopback SSE terminal/error tests; native JavaFX local checks where available.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Window lifetime is separate from conversation lifetime; close/reopen restores completed exchanges within a process and restart is documented to clear them.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Service/window ownership inspection and offline native close/recreate probe with a deterministic fake client.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The original local daily launcher starts the reviewed local version with unchanged model/voice settings, protected customizations and animation, with exact-file rollback available.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Scoped install receipt and backup hashes, actual runtime test/package/native startup and identified normal app restart; no inference required.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: All work remains local pending user validation, with no remote publication, CI, merge or fabricated product acceptance.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Local Git/evidence inspection and delivery receipt marked LOCAL_VALIDATION_READY, remote publication NOT_REQUESTED.

risks: Prompt quality and identity fidelity need user/live-model evaluation; deterministic tests verify request composition and lifecycle, not conversational quality.
Recent history is intentionally process-local and bounded; context outside the budget is not summarized or remembered permanently.
The daily runtime includes adopted public-source changes and private service settings; installation must compare exact baselines and preserve unlisted files.
No remote CI or merged release exists for this user-requested local validation stage. Local PASS is not user acceptance.
rollback: Stop only the identified pet app, restore the exact listed source/resource/test backups from .ai-workflow/dialogue-local/backup after verifying installed hashes, remove only newly installed listed paths, rebuild and restart the original daily launcher. Do not alter private configuration or independent voice services.
